items.evidence: apiLevel 2.15 is valid, 100 µL is handled by the p300, and the simulator ran cleanly with no overdispense.
Each of the two 100 µL moves picks up a tip before aspirating and drops it after dispensing. The tip_before_aspirate, tip_dropped_at_end and no_cross_contamination checks all passed.
The protocol aspirates 100 µL from reservoir A1 and dispenses it into plate A1, then does the same for B1, in order. It adds nothing else, and the end_state check passed.
The reservoir (slot 1) and plate (slot 2) are loaded with the required labels. The p20 (left) and p300 (right) use the 20 µL tip rack in slot 10 and the 300 µL tip rack in slot 11.
p300.aspirate(100, reservoir['A1']) then dispense(100, plate[well]) for A1 and B1 only. The end_state check shows [100, 100].

judge.summary: The protocol moves 100 µL with the p300 from reservoir A1 to plate A1 and to plate B1, using a fresh tip for each well and dropping both tips. All measured checks passed, and I found no deviation from the task.
